title: Vote: add specific-name to the UDF spec
summary: Szehon Ho started a vote to add a specific-name field to the UDF spec (PR #16727). The field identifies a specific overload of a UDF and supports the corresponding concept from the SQL spec. The vote was open for 72 hours. All replies in the thread were +1 votes and no questions or concerns about the change were raised there. Szehon added his own binding +1 before closing, and then announced that the vote passed with 5 binding +1 votes, 4 non-binding +1 votes, and no 0 or -1 votes.

positions.stance: Add a specific-name field that identifies a specific UDF overload, matching the SQL spec concept.

outcome.note: Passed with 5 binding and 4 non-binding +1 votes, and no 0 or -1 votes.

why_it_matters: UDF overloads in the spec can be addressed individually by specific-name.
